SELECT w.id AS id, w.title AS title, w.cover AS cover, SUM(d.read_num) AS view_count FROM ai_wiki w INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT c.wiki_id, c.document_id FROM ai_wiki_catalog c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.document_id IS NOT NULL ) c ON w.id = c.wiki_id INNER JOIN ai_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY w.id, w.title ORDER BY view_count DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
